concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: a RADISH FAIRY standing upright, with a ROUND ANIMAL HEAD (not a human girl), crowned with a white camellia in full bloom, the THIRD stage of a three-stage Wood evolution line whose first stage is image 6: a round crimson radish pup, in the same view and pose as image 1, standing upright with both arms held out to the sides, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 round animal head with face; 2 white camellia on the head; 3 leaf collar; 4 body; 5 leaf skirt; 6 radish root feet; 7 viewer-left arm holding a berry; 8 viewer-right arm holding a berry;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 round animal head with face: a ROUND animal head with NO hair, filling the face and hair area: deep crimson-red radish skin on the top, back and sides where the old hair was, a big warm cream face patch in front with a small animal muzzle; two big dark-brown eyes (one small catchlight dot each) exactly where the old eyes are, brows angled down, a confident grin with a small fang where the old mouth is; not a human face, no hair, no bangs, no nose.
2 white camellia on the head: a big white camellia in full bloom sitting on top of the head: the petals become wide rounded white camellia petals in the same places (thin warm-grey lines between petals, no pink); the three stalks become short thick deep-crimson stamens with round crimson tips standing up from the centre.
3 leaf collar: a collar of dark forest-green leaves with olive midribs: a wide leaf spreading behind the neck to both sides and two leaf tips curling up at the front of the shoulders, the same shapes and places; no gold.
4 body: a deep crimson-red radish torso with a warm cream belly patch in front, its leafy lower edge dark forest green; the waist oval dark forest green.
5 leaf skirt: a skirt of three big dark forest-green leaves with olive midribs and a thin olive rim.
6 radish root feet: three deep crimson-red radish-root lobes peeking out under the skirt, each tapering to a thin cream root tip pointing down.
7 viewer-left arm holding a berry: a deep crimson-red arm ending in a cream paw with three short fingers at the bottom-left end; the paw clutches one plump round deep-red berry with a tiny dark-green leaf cap, drawn inside the paw outline; the shoulder leaf is a dark forest-green leaf sleeve.
8 viewer-right arm holding a berry: a deep crimson-red arm ending in a cream paw with three short fingers at the bottom-right end; the paw clutches one plump round deep-red berry with a tiny dark-green leaf cap, drawn inside the paw outline; the shoulder leaf is a dark forest-green leaf sleeve.

ATTITUDE: a proud flower fighter: brows angled down, a confident grin with a small fang; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those. Image 6 is the approved first stage of this creature: keep its colours, face and drawing style; this stage is the same creature grown up.

COLOURS: deep crimson-red radish skin, a warm cream face-and-belly patch, dark forest-green leaves with olive midribs, big dark-brown eyes, a big white camellia with deep-crimson stamens, plump deep-red berries. Few colours.

AVOID: pale washed-out green, a pale green or whitish body, pink flowers or petals, purple bells, a human face or human hair, glowing dots, sparkles, a pink lily, yellow stamens on long stalks, a golden collar, a human girl's face, hair or bangs, pale green skin, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
